seo.title: Memento — A photobooth archive of moments worth keeping
seo.description: Memento is an experience-driven photobooth in Malang, Indonesia. Vintage-inspired portraits, distinctive lighting and thoughtfully designed prints.

hero.title:
Some moments
deserve to *stay.*
hero.lede: Memento is a photobooth for the people you love and the versions of yourself you want to remember. Vintage at heart, made with modern light, printed to be kept.

about.label: About Memento
about.title:
Not just a photograph.
*Something to keep.*
about.paragraph1: We started Memento because a photograph should do more than prove you were there. It should bring the evening back: who stood closest, who laughed first, how the light fell across your face.
about.paragraph2: So we built a booth around people. A warm, private space where you can stop performing and simply be with each other, then walk away holding something real.

principles.title: People first
principles.text: We celebrate genuine moments, never forced poses.

principles.title: Personal by design
principles.text: Your face, your people, your look. Photography that feels like yours.

principles.title: The smallest details
principles.text: Light, image quality, the edge of every frame: considered, then considered again.

principles.title: Made to revisit
principles.text: Prints for the wallet and the wall. Files to share. Moments to return to.

archive.label: The Archive
archive.title:
Faces, friends &
*everything in between.*
archive.intro: Real results from the Memento booth. Filter by who was in the frame, or by the look they chose.

frame.label: Find Your Frame
frame.title:
Your moment,
*your way.*
frame.intro: Every session begins with two choices: the look of your photograph and the world you step into. Explore them here.
frame.backdropTitle:
Choose the world
you step into.

booth.label: The Memento Experience
booth.title:
An experience
worth *stepping into.*
booth.intro: Draw the curtain, find the light, forget the world for a minute. The rest is yours to keep.

photos.caption: The wall of everyone who came before.

features.title: High-quality photography
features.text: Professional-grade capture with crisp detail and honest colour, every single frame.

features.title: Distinctive lighting
features.text: Light shaped to flatter and to feel like a mood, not a flash in the face.

features.title: Curated frames
features.text: Print layouts designed with the same care as the photographs inside them.

features.title: Physical prints
features.text: Something to hold, to tuck into a wallet, to pin above a desk.

features.title: Digital keepsakes
features.text: Your photographs to save and share, long after the night ends.

features.title: Comfortable & easy
features.text: A private, unhurried space. Step in, settle in, be yourselves.

prints.label: The Prints
prints.title:
Small enough to carry.
*Made to last.*
prints.intro: Every Memento print is composed like a page from a photo book: generous borders, balanced frames and our signature quietly in the corner.
prints.detailCaption: Detail — the strip, out in the world.

locations.label: Find Memento
locations.title: Where to *find us.*
locations.intro: Follow the red glow. New locations are added here as they open.

partner.label: Work With Memento
partner.title:
Let’s make room
for *more memories.*
partner.intro: We partner with cafés, restaurants, lifestyle spaces, brands and event organisers who care about how people feel in their space. A Memento booth gives guests a reason to stay longer, and something to take home that carries your name.

points.title: For venues
points.text: A permanent booth that becomes part of your space and your guests’ routine.

points.title: For brands
points.text: Custom backdrops and frames that put your story into every print.

points.title: For events
points.text: A pop-up booth for launches, celebrations and private gatherings.
